sampleTexts: $212 at the supermarket and I swear the trolley is half as full as it was two years ago.
Everyone in my group chat is comparing Aldi vs Woolies receipts this week lol
The block of cheese is $14. FOURTEEN. Ok we're done, switching to home brand everything.
My weekly shop costs what my rent was in 2019. How is anyone with kids doing this?
Watched a bloke put back the steaks and grab mince instead. That's the economy right there.
Petrol jumped 25c overnight at every servo near me. Fill up tonight if you haven't.
Fuel app says cheapest near me is $2.35. The school run is about to cost a fortune.
Everyone topping up before the long weekend, queue around the block at Costco fuel.
Went for the 9pm session, sold out. 11pm, sold out. Haven't seen a cinema like this in years.
Everyone at work saw it this weekend. Everyone. The group chat is just spoiler warnings now.
Box office tracking says it might beat $100M opening. Cinemas are BACK.
took the kids, place was packed, popcorn line 40 minutes. worth it though
It's the first movie in ages my parents AND my nephew both wanted to see.
